concerns.text: The specification limits the model to only twelve compositional descriptors (atomic radii, electronegativity, oxidation states, valence electron counts for A, B, X sites) and provides no provision for incorporating structural or electronic environment features. The original idea’s research question explicitly asks how compositional descriptors *correlate* with defect formation energies *across different perovskite crystal structures*, implying that structural context may be relevant. By omitting any fallback or exploratory step to assess or include structural descriptors when the compositional models fail to meet the target RMSE <0.5 eV or R² ≥ 70 %, the spec narrows the research question and risks model misspecification. This constitutes a methodological drift/under‑reach relative to the idea.
